title: Savior, Who Thy Flock Art Feeding
description: Savior, Who Thy Flock Art Feeding in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by William Augustus Mühlenberg, first published in 1826. The tune, BATTY, is from Johann Thommen's Musicalischer Christenschatz, Basel, 1745. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: Sa-vior, who Thy flock art feed-ing With the Shep-herd's kind-est care, All the fee-ble_ gent-ly_ lead-ing, While the lambs Thy bos-om share.

lines: Savior, who Thy flock art feeding
While the lambs Thy bosom share.
Fold them in Thy gracious arm;
There, we know, Thy Word believing,
Let them be the lion's prey;
Keep them through life's dang'rous way.
Let them find a resting place,
Drink the rivers of Thy grace.
